name: 泥潭二
group_note: 泥潭二 (Mud Swamp 2) -- an ES2/Annihilator-derived lineage distinct from nt6/nitan (own already-complete 2-arg set/query/delete architecture in feature/dbase.lpc, no §7.15 bug). WASM pass fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() (both the active and a dead-code-duplicate commented-out version used byte ranges; replaced the active one with the codepoint check) plus TWO independently-recurring instances of the unhalved-length-bound variant -- logind.lpc's check_legal_name(arg, 4) (should be 2, matching its own 'no more than 2 hanzi' prompt) at 2 call sites, its combined-name strlen(fname) < 4 (should be < 2), and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() strlen(name) < 2 (should be < 1, was rejecting every single-character given name as 'empty'). (2) §1.3e uptime()<30 gate in logind.lpc's logon() -- bypassed for loopback. (3) §7.52 socket-daemon gutting on TWO separate daemons: dns_master.lpc (small, single-purpose, gutted wholesale) and versiond.lpc (large multi-purpose release-sync daemon with 32 external callers of its non-socket functions like is_version_ok()/query() -- gutted only the 13 socket-touching functions/callbacks, left the rest of the public interface intact per the standing large-multi-purpose-daemon guidance). (4) §7.50 accept_kill()'s is_killing(ob) object/string mismatch in user.lpc (is_killing(ob->query("id"))), the same recurring copy-paste bug seen on nt1/wxddym/zjmudhell/hell. Seeded fluffos/AdminPass1+loginpw1 (two-password scheme) as admin via adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed routed to the wizard-only start room on registration. Full registration->look->quit (including quit's new-account deletion-confirmation) verified before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean -- the two large-diff outliers were versiond.lpc's own gutting and combatd.lpc's legitimate if-else-if damage-message-ladder collapsing, not corruption). Same in-universe 'not yet born until you complete a birth-ritual NPC dialogue' content gate as nt6/nt6nitan6win affects score for a freshly registered character -- not a bug, out of scope.
